1.t: O you covered up ˹in your clothes˺

6.t: Do not do a favour expecting more ˹in return˺

7.t: And persevere for ˹the sake of˺ your Lord

8.t: ˹For˺ when the Trumpet will be sounded

9.t: that will ˹truly˺ be a difficult Day—

10.t: far from easy for the disbelievers

11.t: And leave to me ˹O Prophet˺ the one I created all by Myself

13.t: and children always by his side

14.t: and made life very easy for him

15.t: Yet he is hungry for more

16.t: But no! ˹For˺ he has been truly stubborn with Our revelations

17.t: I will make his fate unbearable

18.t: for he contemplated and determined ˹a degrading label for the Quran˺

19.t: May he be condemned! How evil was what he determined

20.t: May he be condemned even more! How evil was what he determined

23.t: then turned his back ˹on the truth˺ and acted arrogantly

24.t: saying, “This ˹Quran˺ is nothing but magic from the ancients
24.tr: Faqaala in haazaaa illaa sihruny yu'sar

25.t: This is no more than the word of a man.”

26.t: Soon I will burn him in Hell

27.t: And what will make you realize what Hell is

28.t: It does not let anyone live or die

31.t: We have appointed only ˹stern˺ angels as wardens of the Fire. And We have made their number only as a test for the disbelievers, so that the People of the Book will be certain, and the believers will increase in faith, and neither the People of the Book nor the believers will have any doubts, and so that those ˹hypocrites˺ with sickness in their hearts and the disbelievers will argue, “What does Allah mean by such a number?” In this way Allah leaves whoever He wills to stray and guides whoever He wills. And none knows the forces of your Lord except He. And this ˹description of Hell˺ is only a reminder to humanity
31.tr: Wa-maa ja'alnaaa As-haaban naari illaa malaaa-'ikatanw Wa-maa ja'alnaa 'iddatahum illaa fitnatal lillazeena kafaroo liyastaiqinal lazeena ootul kitaaba Wa-yazdaadal lazeena aamanooo eemaananw Wa-laa yartaabal lazeena ootul kitaaba walmu'minoona Wa-liyaqoolal lazeena fee quloo-bihim maradunw walkaafiroona maazaaa araadal laahu bihaazaa masalaa; kazaalika yudillul laahu mai yashaaa'u Wa-yahdee mai yashaaa'; Wa-maa ya'lamu junooda rabbika illaa hoo; Wa-maa hiya illaa zikraa lil-bashar

33.t: and the night as it retreats

34.t: and the day as it breaks

35.t: Surely Hell is one of the mightiest catastrophes—

37.t: to whichever of you chooses to take the lead or lag behind
37.tr: Liman shaaa'a minkum any yataqaddama aw yata-akhkhar

38.t: Every soul will be detained for what it has done

39.t: except the people of the right

40.t: who will be in Gardens, asking one another

41.t: about the wicked ˹who will then be asked˺

43.t: They will reply, “We were not of those who prayed

44.t: nor did we feed the poor

45.t: We used to indulge ˹in falsehood˺ along with others

46.t: and deny the Day of Judgment

47.t: until the inevitable came to us.”

48.t: So the pleas of intercessors will be of no benefit to them

49.t: Now, what is the matter with them that they are turning away from the reminder

50.t: as if they were spooked zebras

52.t: In fact, each one of them wishes to be given a ˹personal˺ letter ˹from Allah˺ for all ˹to read˺
52.tr: Bal yureedu kullum ri'im minhum any yu'taa suhufam munashsharah

53.t: But no! In fact, they do not fear the Hereafter

54.t: Enough! Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a reminder

55.t: So let whoever wills be mindful of it

56.t: But they cannot do so unless Allah wills. He ˹alone˺ is worthy to be feared and entitled to forgive
56.tr: Wa-maa yazkuroona illaaa any yashaaa'al laah; Huwa ahlut taqwaa Wa-ahlul maghfirah
